provenance.instrument: Codified Ordinances of the Municipality of Penn Hills, Part Twelve Planning and Zoning Code, Title Six Zoning (Chapters 1260 to 1288), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code PE4297): includes legislation through 07-20-2026. New Laws (2): Ord. 2026-2714 (Charter) and Ord. 2026-2715 (Shade Tree Commission). Neither touches zoning. eCode360 is Cloudflare-walled for plain fetches. Text was read in a browser from the print view of Part Twelve. Census name is Penn Hills township. The municipality calls itself Municipality of Penn Hills.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Includes legislation through 07-20-2026. New Laws (2) not yet codified, neither about zoning.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law or accessory apartment provision
R-1, R-1A, R-2, R-3 and C permit single-family residences and accessory uses. 'Structures and uses not clearly permitted ... are prohibited' (1268.02)
'Only one principal residential structure shall be located on a zoning lot' except in planned developments and R-4 to R-7 (1278.04)

In R-2, converting a single-family residence to a two-family residence is a special exception: lot at least 7,500 sq ft, house at least 1,600 sq ft, each unit at least 500 sq ft, four off-street spaces not in the front yard (1268.05(c)(1))
Two-family residences are permitted in R-4 (1268.02(e))
A dwelling unit is living quarters for one family (1260.07)
No accessory building setback or height rules were found. Accessory buildings are not permitted obstructions in required yards (1278.06(e)). Ask the zoning office
Single-family dwellings need two parking spaces per dwelling unit (1278.02)

Table I caps density: R-1 5, R-1A 4, R-2 8, R-3 3 dwelling units per acre (1268.06). An R-2 conversion on a 7,500 sq ft lot is about 11.6 units per acre. Table I adds: 'Bulk and area regulations for uses permitted as special exceptions shall be established by the Zoning Hearing Board'
No permanent accessory building may be built before the principal structure (1278.05)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning Department, https://pennhillspa.gov/planning-department/. Pending: none found affecting Part Twelve. The towns index pointed to ecode360 37763696, which was not confirmed. Part Twelve root is 37763757. Searched the full printed Part Twelve (Planning and Zoning Code) for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, elder cottage, ECHO, granny, carriage house, accessory family, secondary dwelling, second dwelling, accessory living, guest house. No ADU term.
